checks.description: Readiness after exclusive UART admission, exact live PID/device/capture binding and acknowledgment; any failure prevents HID.
Exactly one fixed reviewed emitted HID sequence, explicit CAD burst/release risk and pinned orderly mapping; abnormal exits restore recreated receive-only capture without retry.
Meaningful guard and readiness fault/order tests, source/document bindings, separate verification; current boot/environment uncertainty and physical gates explicit.

constraints.text: rbg-01: Signal readiness only after durable private capture admission, exact character device/topology checks, competing-descriptor refusal and TIOCEXCL. Bind the actual child PID plus process identity/liveness, UART identity and owned capture descriptor/inode through the live child channel; reject malformed, stale or replayed readiness. Require parent liveness and one exact attempt-bound acknowledgment; failed callback, timeout, dead child or lost parent stops and releases resources before any serial/HID transmission. Recheck live bindings at the HID boundary; inspection/default mode sends no HID.

Limit the explicit unknown-counter and CAD-risk amendment to one named recovery attempt/one emitted sequence. Bind current amendment/decision provenance in the guard policy; never fabricate fresh_environment_reviewed=True. Preserve the ordinary fresh-environment gate and allow only the explicitly bound exception. Do not assume current boot counters, RTC, preserved environments, U-Boot MMC mapping or exactly one actual reset. Jobs/claims/markers stay disabled. Missed interception, inherited script reset, unexpected reset, timeout, release failure or failed SD return stops all further sender/serial sequence activity without reattempt. Successful return requires both redundant environment CRC/layout/value reads and Linux/RTC comparison before staging, fresh jobs or another reboot.

Accept only the explicitly disclosed retained default CAD burst/stuck-release risk for this one sequence. Bind and cite the actual retained image/package/unit/kernel chain: ordinary CAD requests orderly ctrl-alt-del/reboot targets, while more than seven CAD events within two seconds may select the early emergency force path. Final SuccessAction=reboot-force after shutdown/umount/final ordering is permitted. Do not claim four emitted reports prove one host event/reset, host autorepeat settings, guaranteed release timing or force-path absence. Verify fresh KVM Keyboard gadget metadata and descriptor identity; emit only the fixed eight-byte Ctrl-Alt-F2, release, Ctrl-Alt-Delete, release reports with prompt release and per-report syscall/elapsed receipts. No explicit force command, arbitrary keys, hold/repeated press, power/reset control, retry or second sequence. Failed/partial release is uncertain hardware state and requires stop plus separately reviewed recovery, not a success claim or improvised sender fallback.

Before any operation, the coordinator and immediate independent Sol/high reviewer must bind the named installed spare, retained factory rollback baseline, independent SD/USB recovery/artifacts, PSU-off/printer-disabled state, no armed writer job/claim/marker and no incomplete whole-device transfer to applicable retained evidence. Factory rollback is the owner-selected recovery baseline, not proof that spare persistence cannot be corrupted. State explicitly that missed interception may enter a normal slot, consume attempts and make persistent writes that a burst reset could interrupt. Preserve owner artifacts using existing authorized preservation records; do not treat the factory module as a substitute for any newly introduced irreplaceable spare data. If those premises cannot be established, or unpreserved owner data/new target/expanded recovery authority is involved, stop and return the specific unmet requirement for further review and applicable owner decision. No operation follows from this feature decision alone.

rbg-02: Recreate the bounded receive-only transient collector on success, refusal, timeout and abnormal controller exit; merely starting a removed unit is insufficient. An independently surviving bounded supervisor must restore it after coordinator/primary SSH connection loss as well as controller loss, with actual controller-exit/exclusive-UART arbitration. A finally block alone is insufficient. Supervisor must never send HID, reboot, retry boot or change serial control lines. Retain failed probe/captures/receipts; avoid overwrite or blind rollback, and leave uncertain boot outcome for separate reviewed recovery.

rbg-03: Use actual guard entrypoints and optional serial callback/gate with fake subprocess/HID transports and real private capture fixtures to test admission/order, callback and exact-ack failures, stale/malformed identity, PID death/reuse, parent/SSH loss, partial HID writes, successful four-report ordering and collector recreation after abnormal exit. Prove failed readiness sends zero HID and zero serial TX; prove ordinary freshness refusal still holds. Independent delivery verification must assess changed source plus preserved capture behavior before an immediate separate Sol/high review of any exact physical operation. Source/offline, measured named hardware, and release evidence remain distinct.

Keep one implementer and the five named owned files, with the serial change confined to readiness and explicit exception admission. Reuse unchanged loader/writer/build evidence. Keep scripts/receipts/captures under 64 MiB and isolated scratch under 512 MiB, measure resource use and stop on overrun; no new dependencies/downloads, upstream/build/MCU/writer changes, media/environment writes, policy rearming, credentials/SSH authentication modification or private-key transfer. Use existing coordinator-owned pinned-host-key SSH connections only. Retain existing rollback artifacts without inspecting private backups. Document retirement on supported authenticated recovery reboot/boot selection; this approval grants no hardware operation, commissioning or release authority.

decision.rationale: Approve the explicit CAD risk amendment as a bounded delegated diagnostic recovery design within the existing writerless-eMMC goal, not as hardware permission. The before/after improvement remains failed UART admission followed by erroneous reboot versus live exclusive UART/capture readiness and exact acknowledgment gating one emitted fixed HID sequence, with independently supervised receive-only capture restoration. The actual requirement host-managed-boot-route.md demands fresh environment review; this decision permits only the named one-sequence recovery exception and mandatory post-return inspection. The amendment now accurately admits what the pinned-source clarification established: systemd 257.13 starts the orderly target for ordinary CAD, but the unmodified >7 events/2 seconds burst path and delayed/failed-release autorepeat can cause early forced reset. Normal final SuccessAction=reboot-force after ordered shutdown is compatible with orderly reboot. Four sender reports establish neither one host event nor one reset. This is a procedural risk choice for the already authorized identified spare experiment: docs/hardware/test-sv08-01-recovery.md records the owner-selected factory-module rollback baseline and blank-spare workflow; .codex/current-goals.md retains the writerless recovery goal while optional features are paused. The risk does not intentionally erase artifacts or alter owner persistence/idle/heater/8 GB/pinning requirements; the constraints prevent applying it to unpreserved owner data or another target. Independent recovery availability and the absence of armed writer/incomplete-transfer/printer activity must be established in the exact-operation review, not inferred from the proposal. Boot counters/RTC, SD interception, normal-slot writes and physical release remain unknown. Existing independent source findings and measured failed probe are concrete evidence; implementation tests establish sender/admission behavior only and require independent verification. No replacement owner product decision is required for this confined design amendment, provided these limits hold; extending it to unpreserved data, production hardware, repeated attempts or unavailable recovery requires further review and applicable owner decision. This decision supersedes only the earlier impossible force-path-absence condition; it grants no operation authority, no validation of delivered code and no preservation or single-reset guarantee.

tasks.blocker: Reviewed clean source HEAD 4cc83afe6b9d82b57e5b7c7d8ca1ea18db37663c and entire diff from recorded run base 8ec4b2590ed3e6d417dc7a2fee5e9d14c7f771ed: exactly five owned files, with no extra paths, mode changes, deletions or gitlinks. Approved proposal/requirements/scope and complete decision hashes are fresh; every submitted source/document hash and evidence commit matches. Reproduced all 45 focused guard/serial checks without skips, inspected actual primary/serve/readiness/HID/supervise entrypoints and preserved capture failure paths. rbg-01 admission, actual child PID/starttime/descriptor/source challenge, parent/SSH liveness, exact acknowledgment and ordinary freshness refusal versus explicitly approved exception are supported. Fixed four-report HID behavior, no retry, partial-write/parent-loss stop and independent transient supervisor creation/controller-exit arbitration are supported at offline scope. Exact allowed source-receipt, unit-chain and collector hashes match production constants; current risk decision digest matches RISK_APPROVAL and accurately accepts default CAD burst/stuck-release uncertainty. Material unmet rbg-02/rbg-03 resource constraint: collector_command checks only existing console.raw/events.jsonl total<=8MiB and launches the pinned collector for 12h without an enforced file/aggregate byte limit. Actual pinned collector caps raw payload at50MiB but appends an unbounded JSON event on every read. Bounded disposable execution of its actual event function for1000 one-byte receives wrote89893 event-log bytes for1000 payload bytes; conservatively this exceeds4.7GB of event output before its50MiB payload limit, violating the approved64MiB aggregate capture budget. Existing test covers initial retained size only. Add guard-owned enforced limits without changing pinned collector, for example systemd LimitFSIZE=4M plus Restart=no and consistent per-file preflight/stop documentation. Demonstrate real disposable subprocess RLIMIT_FSIZE enforcement and fixed launch arguments, retained capped files, no retry and aggregate headroom; reject incompatible preexisting file sizes without deleting them. A file-size limit would provide a simple bounded correction without an aggregate-monitor dependency. Delivered five-file size82019bytes, no build scratch/new dependencies, diff/cached/Markdown and lock/index checks pass. No hardware/private backups/credentials were accessed. Named spare/rollback/preservation/no-writer/PSU-off premises, one emitted sequence risk, actual reset/SD return, post-return redundant environment/RTC checks and immediate Sol/high operation review remain explicit physical dependencies. This failure concerns offline resource acceptance, not lack of a physical reset; no hardware or release is certified.

evidence.limitations: Offline sender/admission evidence only; physical keyboard event/reset count, SD return and fresh environment/RTC require separate Sol/high exact operation review; no source-only force/reset/release guarantee.
evidence.method: Live after-exclusive-admission PID/starttime/descriptors and nonce-bound challenge; ordinary freshness refusal and explicit one-attempt unknown-counter/risk provenance gates.

evidence.method: Four fixed HID reports with identity and syscall/time receipts, no repeat; actual independently surviving bounded supervisor recreates receive-only collector after real disposable child/channel exit. Exact retained CAD source and explicit default burst/release risk pins.

evidence.method: 45 focused guard+serial checks pass without skips; meaningful failed readiness/ack/PID/parent/SSH/source/capture/partial-HID and collector restoration/order fixtures; documentation links/diff pass. Five owned paths82019bytes; no build scratch/new dependencies.
